summary: Why your organisation exists. The vision says where it wants to get to, and the mission says what it does to get there.
example: Vision: every member family earns a fair living from what it grows. Mission: we collect, check and sell our members' produce together.
definition: Why your organisation exists. The vision is the future your organisation wants for the people it serves. The mission is what your organisation does, and for whom, to get there. If they are already published, copy the words exactly and say where they come from.

cues.purpose: a vision or mission: the reason an organisation exists

/spec/organisation.guide: The name your organisation's own people use for it.

poor.why: Not a name. Give the name people use for your organisation.

/spec/vision.guide: The future your organisation wants for the people it serves, not what it does. Leave out figures; they go in your goals' measures.
good: Every member can make a dependable living from what they grow.

poor.why: A target, not a vision. Put the figure and the date in a goal's measures.
Too vague. Say what the future looks like, and for whom.

poor.text: We collect, check and sell our members' produce.
poor.why: What the organisation does is the mission; the vision is the future it is working towards.

/spec/mission.guide: What your organisation does, and for whom, to reach the vision. Describe its ongoing work, not a list of projects.
good: We collect, check and sell our members' produce together, so each member gets a fair and dependable price for a season's work.

poor.text: Roll out quality checks at every depot and open two new depots.
poor.why: This lists projects, which end. The mission is the work your organisation always does.
Values, not a mission: they do not say what the organisation does.

/spec/source.guide: The document where the vision and mission are published, with the section or page. Leave it empty if they are not published anywhere.

poor.why: Too vague to find again. Name the document and the section or page.

/metadata/name.guide: The name for this record, such as Purpose, or the word your plan uses for its vision and mission.

checks.purpose-organisation: Name the organisation, as its own people say it.
checks.purpose-vision: Write the future your organisation is working towards, using its own documents where they say it.
checks.purpose-mission: Write what your organisation does to reach its vision, using its own documents where they say it.
